title: Puharich's prosthetic finger with an ELF chip

tellings.quote: he says in his own words, he invented this prosthetic finger that would have a a chip with a certain ELF frequency that

plain: In the 1970s the inventor and researcher Andrija Puharich said he had built an artificial finger carrying a chip that gave off a set extremely low frequency, or ELF, a kind of very slow radio wave. An unnamed guest on the show repeats this, saying Puharich describes it "in his own words". It is told as an example of Puharich using these frequencies to affect the human body.
